semantics.rust_signature: fn checkpoint_exact_native(inputs: &[Tensor], use_reentrant: bool, cancellation: &CancellationToken, function: F) -> Result<CheckpointExecution, ElementwiseRuntimePartSixError>
semantics.mutation_rule: records immutable input handles and versions; recomputation publishes only complete outputs
semantics.alias_rule: saved inputs use canonical Tensor copy on write and outputs retain the function alias contract
semantics.shape_rule: forward and recomputation output arity must match
semantics.dtype_rule: preserves the wrapped function dtype contract
semantics.layout_rule: preserves the wrapped function layout contract
semantics.device_rule: preserves explicit input devices without process global state
semantics.numeric_rule: reentrant forward executes in no grad mode and replay executes with gradients enabled; nonreentrant forward executes enabled
semantics.tolerance: bit exact when the wrapped function is deterministic
semantics.determinism: explicit replay over version checked saved inputs
semantics.cancellation_points: before forward, after forward, before version checks, during replay, and before replay publication
semantics.vjp_rule: caller replays the wrapped function with GradientMode enabled and records its canonical backward rules
semantics.jvp_rule: caller replays the wrapped function with GradientMode enabled and records its canonical tangent rules
